## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Cryo-EM structure reveals etravirine as a PRMT5/pICln PPI inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42710907/)** — *PubMed*
  * Structure-based screening identified the HIV drug etravirine as a specific inhibitor of the PRMT5/pICln protein-protein interaction.
  * Demonstrates an alternative targeted therapeutic strategy for prostate cancer models.

* **[Network modeling identifies targetable mTOR/PI3K pathways in MYBPC3-mutant HCM](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.749173)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Integrated a truncating mutation (`MYBPC3` W1078/W1082) into a computational signaling network model of familial hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).
  * Predicted and confirmed that the `MYBPC3` mutation drives pathological cardiac hypertrophy primarily via mTOR and PI3K signaling cascades.

* **[Mendelian randomization refutes causal link between GLP-1R activation and NAION](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.06.26362369)** — *medRxiv*
  * Analysis of FAERS data showed a post-publication spike in non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION) reporting with semaglutide (ROR = 116.8), consistent with notoriety reporting bias rather than cumulative toxicity.
  * *GLP1R* cis-eQTL Mendelian randomization demonstrated no causal effect of genetically proxied GLP-1R activation on NAION risk across evaluated ocular phenotypes (all `p ≥ 0.11`).

* **[Ivosidenib, but not enasidenib, drives IDH VAF clearance in responder myeloid malignancies](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26361825)** — *medRxiv*
  * A retrospective analysis of 79 patients with *IDH*-mutated myeloid malignancies treated with ivosidenib (*IDH1*) or enasidenib (*IDH2*) showed similar composite complete hematologic response (CHR) rates (43%).
  * Ivosidenib-treated patients achieving CHR demonstrated a significant reduction in *IDH1* variant allele frequency (VAF; `p = 0.010`), whereas no significant VAF reduction occurred in enasidenib CHR responders.

* **[Chemogenomic profiling uncovers PRDX1-dependent iron-damage axis in DNA repair](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42711491/)** — *PubMed*
  * Chemogenomic mapping identified a peroxiredoxin 1 (PRDX1)-dependent iron-damage axis critical to the DNA damage response.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Roivant’s mosliciguat achieves 56% PVR reduction in Phase 2 PH-ILD trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roivant-astrazeneca-etcamah-GPRC5D-pharvaris-inhibrx/829763/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Mosliciguat met primary and secondary endpoints in a Phase 2 trial of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD).
  * The inhaled sGC activator reduced pulmonary vascular resistance by 56%, setting up Phase 3 development.

* **[First-in-human trial validates inhaled siRNA targeting RAGE for lung inflammation](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04607-z)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A randomized Phase 1 trial evaluated an inhaled, lung-epithelium-targeted siRNA directed against the receptor for advanced glycation end-products (RAGE).
  * Treatment was safe and well-tolerated, successfully lowering RAGE levels in serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid.

* **[Camrelizumab plus nimotuzumab demonstrates efficacy in Phase 2 ESCC trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42711069/)** — *PubMed*
  * A multicenter Phase 2 study evaluated anti-PD-1 mAb camrelizumab combined with anti-EGFR mAb nimotuzumab as second-line therapy for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC).

* **[Mitiperstat fails Phase 2b trial in heart failure with preserved or mildly reduced EF](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04615-z)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A randomized Phase 2b trial testing myeloperoxidase (MPO) inhibitor mitiperstat failed to hit its primary endpoints.
  * MPO inhibition did not lead to improvement in clinical symptoms or exercise capacity in patients with HFpEF or HFmrEF.

* **[Biotech]** **[Pyxis Oncology updates Phase 1 data for micvotabart pelidotin in head and neck cancer](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097641668807729635)** — *BioStocks*
  * Reported positive updated results from a Phase 1 monotherapy trial evaluating micvotabart pelidotin (MICVO).
  * Evaluated patients with second-line and beyond recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).

* **[Biotech]** **[Cocrystal Pharma completes dosing in Phase 1b norovirus challenge trial](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097644405880467463)** — *BioStocks*
  * Dosed the final subject in a Phase 1b human challenge study evaluating antiviral candidate CDI-988 for norovirus prevention and treatment.
  * Preliminary data from the trial are expected in late 2026 or early 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **[Kazia Therapeutics doses first patient in pediatric brain cancer trial](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097649108508918262)** — *BioStocks*
  * Initiated dosing in the PNOC035 clinical study evaluating paxalisib.
  * The trial targets pediatric patients with recurrent atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor (AT/RT) brain cancer.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Bristol Myers Squibb faces scrutiny over uncontrolled study claims](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2097306608422228227)** — *Jacob Plieth*
  * Claimed statistical significance for data from its Quintessential clinical trial.
  * Industry observers noted the trial lacks a control arm, raising methodological questions regarding the significance claims.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca’s tozorakimab cuts COPD exacerbations in Phase 3 trials](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/08/astrazeneca-tozorakimab-copd-exacerbations-titania-oberon/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  * Anti-IL-33 monoclonal antibody tozorakimab demonstrated positive results in the TITANIA and OBERON Phase 3 studies in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
  * Data position the candidate to compete in the biological treatment landscape for severe COPD.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Novartis RNA-targeting therapy del-desiran fails Phase 3 myotonic dystrophy trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novartis-rna-drug-failure-dm1-avidity-del-desiran/829778/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Del-desiran failed to meet its primary endpoint in a pivotal Phase 3 study in patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1).
  * The therapeutic failed to demonstrate a statistically significant improvement over placebo on measures of hand muscle relaxation.

* **[Biotech]** **[Compass Pathways reports 52-week open-label Phase 3 COMP005 data](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097636912047493130)** — *BioStocks*
  * Released topline 52-week open-label results from Part C of the Phase 3 COMP005 trial evaluating COMP360 (psilocybin).
  * Administration of a second dose yielded additional therapeutic benefit and extended treatment durability out to one year.

* **[Biotech]** **[Rezolute provides update on Phase 3 hyperinsulinism programs](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097643036448575733)** — *BioStocks*
  * Data from the Phase 3 sunRIZE trial in congenital hyperinsulinism remain under active FDA review.
  * Topline results from the ongoing Phase 3 upLIFT trial are expected before the end of the year.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves AstraZeneca breast cancer drug](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/08/biotech-news-fda-approves-astrazeneca-breast-cancer-drug/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  * FDA granted clearance for AstraZeneca's new breast cancer therapy.

* **[FDA issues warning letter to API manufacturer over facility contamination](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/08/fda-warns-api-supplier-residue-corroded-production-line-sandals/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  * FDA cited an active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) supplier following an inspection revealing residue on walls, corroded production lines, and safety equipment violations.

* **[FDA updates qualification metrics for drug development tools and ISTAND programs](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-development-tool-ddt-qualification-programs/summary-metrics-drug-development-tool-qualification-projects-submitted-fda)** — *FDA*
  * Agency published updated metrics covering the Drug Development Tool (DDT) Qualification Program and ISTAND program submissions.

* **[FDA publishes bi-weekly Competitive Generic Therapy approval updates](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/generic-drugs/competitive-generic-therapy-approvals)** — *FDA*
  * Updated list of approved Abbreviated New Drug Applications (ANDAs) designated with Competitive Generic Therapy (CGT) exclusivity.

* **[Biotech]** **[Autolus Therapeutics granted FDA RMAT designation for obe-cel in lupus](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097641960655778112)** — *BioStocks*
  * Received Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation for obecabtagene autoleucel (obe-cel).
  * The designation covers treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and lupus nephritis.

* **[FDA issues digital protocol guidance and ARC rare disease strategic plan](http://www.fda.gov/about-fda/accelerating-rare-disease-cures-arc-program/rare-disease-news-events)** — *FDA*
  * Published the M11 Clinical Electronic Structured Harmonised Protocol guidance detailing recommendations, templates, and technical specifications for standardized digital trial protocols.
  * CDER's Accelerating Rare Disease Cures (ARC) Program released its 2025–2030 Strategic Plan outlining initiatives to accelerate rare disease drug development.

* **[FDA OPDP logs untitled letters across commercial drug portfolios](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/warning-letters-and-notice-violation-letters-pharmaceutical-companies/untitled-letters)** — *FDA*
  * Office of Prescription Drug Promotion posted untitled letters addressing promotional communications for products including Alar Pharmaceuticals' ALA-3000 (ketamine pamoate), Travere's Filspari (sparsentan), Sanofi's Beyfortus (nirsevimab-alip), and Viatris's Tobi Podhaler (tobramycin).

* **[BMC Medical recalls 20,160 CPAP units over firmware defect](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/bmc-medical-co-ltd-recalls-luna-g3-apap-model-lg3600-firmware-g3-20076-due-firmware-defect)** — *FDA*
  * Retrospectively reported a US recall of Luna G3 APAP (Model LG3600) devices.
  * The recall affects devices running firmware version G3-2.00.76 due to a software defect.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[Solstice Oncology launches with $225M Series A for anti-CTLA-4 antibody](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/solstice-immuno-oncology-cancer-series-a-launch/829811/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Solstice Oncology emerged from stealth with $225 million in Series A funding backed by RA Capital Management, Canaan Partners, and Forbion.
  * Lead asset porustobart, a CTLA-4 mAb licensed from Harbour Biomed for $105 million upfront ($1.2 billion total deal value), will advance to Phase 2 trials in colon cancer by year-end.

* **[Biotech]** **[Caspian Therapeutics spins out with $50M to advance menin inhibitors in diabetes](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/09/kura-oncology-spins-off-diabetes-focused-caspian-therapeutics/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News* / *[BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097642665365877060)*
  * Caspian Therapeutics launched with $50 million in Series A financing led by BVF Partners, alongside Eli Lilly, the T1D Fund, Invus, and Montanova.
  * The spinout leverages leukemia clinical data from parent Kura Oncology to develop menin inhibitors as potential disease-modifying therapies for diabetes and metabolic disease.

* **[Biotech]** **[Moonwalk Biosciences raises $70M Series B to expand RNAi obesity pipeline](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/moonwalk-series-b-obesity-rna-interference/829784/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Moonwalk secured $70 million in Series B funding to advance an RNA interference program in obesity, licensed from a Chinese biopharma firm.

* **[Biotech]** **[MannKind partners with Rose Pharma on inhaled GLP-1 candidate](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097635070232134011)** — *BioStocks*
  * Executed an exclusive licensing and collaboration agreement to develop an inhaled, rapid-acting, short-duration GLP-1 receptor agonist for weight management.
  * MannKind receives an equity stake in Rose Pharma alongside potential future sales royalties.

* **[Radiopharmaceutical consolidation highlights divergence in pharma portfolio strategy](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2097334150034325603)** — *Andrew Pannu*
  * Market mapping highlights Novartis's scale, committing >$12 billion across 13+ radiopharma transactions since 2017 (including AAA, Endocyte, and Mariana Oncology), generating ~$1.8 billion in H1 2026 revenues from Lutathera and Pluvicto.
  * The strategy contrasts with recent targeted acquisitions by Bristol Myers Squibb ($4.1 billion for RayzeBio), AstraZeneca ($2.4 billion for Fusion Pharma), and Eli Lilly ($1.4 billion for POINT Biopharma).

## Public Health & Policy

* **[Japan enacts binding legislation regulating heritable human genome editing](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04641-x)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Japan has passed formal legislation regulating and placing statutory limits on heritable human genome editing research and clinical applications.

* **[Frontline worker infection patterns in DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.06.26362361)** — *medRxiv*
  * Longitudinal tracking of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in DRC showed health-worker infections peaked early (contributing 11.0% of cases initially) before declining to 2.2–2.6% of cumulative cases.

***

**Worth watching:** Caspian's pivot of oncology-derived menin inhibitors into metabolic disease represents a novel mechanism-repurposing strategy to monitor as clinical studies near. Meanwhile, keep an eye on late-stage clinical readouts: Rezolute's Phase 3 upLIFT study in congenital hyperinsulinism is expected before year-end, while preliminary data from Cocrystal's Phase 1b norovirus challenge trial (CDI-988) are anticipated in late 2026 or early 2027.
